items.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022
items.q: Yes that was a duo recording with a British drummer, Eddie Prevost.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Marilyn Crispell with me today, a pianist and composer. I don’t know what it’s like in Woodstock but it’s pretty cold here in Clinton. So I thought I’d warm you up with a quote about you from the All Music Guide to Jazz. And the reviewer was commenting on a recording you did called “Band on the Wall.” Was that a duo recording?
Yes that was a duo recording with a British drummer, Eddie Prevost.

So this reviewer said: “A very talented pianist who can play with tremendous power and freedom. Also not afraid to ring out sincere emotions on straight ahead forward melodies. If you were able to write your own description of yourself, what would you like people to hear from you?
